name: AvoCook
subtitle: Recipes, groceries, meal plans
promotionalText: New: timers in the Dynamic Island, a widget, Siri, stock linked to your shopping, daily backups and new app icons. Still free, ad-free and working offline.
shortDescription: Recipes, meal plans, pantry and shared grocery lists. Free, no ads, offline.
description:
Hi! I'm a student and I build AvoCook in my spare time. It started because I just wanted a tidy place for my recipes. Now it also tells me what we're eating this week, what's left in the fridge and what to grab on the way home. It's free, open source, ad-free, and you don't need an account.

YOUR RECIPES
• Photos, categories and adjustable servings: quantities update on their own.
• Import from a link: paste the address or share the page from your browser, then check it before saving.
• Print, share as a PDF, or turn your favourites into an illustrated cookbook with a cover and contents page.

IN THE KITCHEN
• Step-by-step cooking with timers that keep running even if you leave the app.
• On iPhone, they show up in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen.
• Voice commands on supported devices, so you don't have to touch the screen with floury hands.
• A private notebook for your tweaks and what you thought of the dish.

YOUR WEEK, PLANNED
Plan lunch and dinner: recipes, quick meals, leftovers or eating out. Adjust servings, move a meal to another day, save your favourite menus and look back at what you ate in the history.

FRIDGE, PANTRY AND FREEZER
Keep track of what you have, with quantities and dates. Scan a barcode to find the product and its Open Food Facts scores, and get a reminder before something expires. Checked-off groceries can go straight into your stock, and the stock updates after you cook.

GROCERIES, ALONE OR TOGETHER
Add ingredients from a recipe or your meal plan and pick only what you're missing. Share a list with a 6-character code: everyone sees changes live and gets a notification. You can also use a Nextcloud Pantry list or sync with Reminders on iPhone.

IDEAS FOR WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
• Find a recipe with whatever's left in the fridge.
• Check what's in season (11 regional calendars).
• Conversions and baking substitutions, always at hand.
• Discover recipes from the AvoCook community, translate them into your language and share your own.
• An optional fridge assistant can suggest a recipe draft from a photo, using your own API key.

ON IPHONE
Timers in Live Activities, a Today widget, Siri shortcuts and Spotlight search. And if you like, you can change the app icon.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
AvoCook works fully on your device, even offline. If you have a Nextcloud server, you can sync recipes with the Cookbook app, and your kitchen (meal plan, stock, notes) between your devices. A backup is made automatically every day, and you can export your whole recipe book whenever you want. Nothing is sold, and your Nextcloud login is encrypted on the device.

Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian and Danish.

Got an idea or found a bug? Get in touch from the app or on GitHub, I read everything.

AvoCook is an independent app compatible with Nextcloud Cookbook. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nextcloud GmbH.
